Priority is set by one rule. Fail = High. AI opinion (not met) = High when the rule is mandatory, otherwise Medium. Query = Medium when the rule is mandatory, otherwise Low. AI opinion (met) and Pass = blank. Mandatory means a held rule that is not marked as a recommendation ('should'); a checklist item has no stored strength and counts as not mandatory.

Fail = a figure its code compared and found out of limit (rank 'Out of limit'). Pass = a safety tick: a compliant verdict its code reached through a safety-tier rule, for the engineer to tick. AI opinion = an AI engineering check, clause review, spec kit item or web standard check (a draft until an engineer confirms). Query = every other row; nothing is proven.
